Commercial Director Executive Summary & Action Plan

1. Throughput & High Conversion:

Marwan demonstrates top-tier operational output in handling high-velocity maintenance consumables, achieving a 74.5% conversion rate and safely delivering 15.91M EGP of essential plant spares into warehouses with zero quality rejections.

2. Overdue Order Expediting:

The primary bottleneck is 64 supplier overdue purchase orders, particularly in imported mechanical seals (Burgmann) and hydraulic hoses. Recommended: Conduct weekly expediting sessions with local agents to enforce contractual delivery milestones.

3. Blanket Contract Sourcing:

With 77 recurring items ordered repeatedly across spot batches, transitioning the top 15 fast-movers to 1-Year Blanket Purchase Agreements (BPAs) will compress procurement cycle time by 60% and free up capacity for strategic sourcing.
